summary: Phase 5 is the earliest feasibility gate for the whole v3 multi-anchor architecture, and it FAILS. The frozen §Q4 base-case deliverable endCharN0_correct (unconditional, arbitrary env : Fin n -> M.carrier, evaluated at env 0, biconditional to the full arity-n atom layer nf_eval_nf M 0 n env qnf) is PROVABLY UNPROVABLE. Root cause: TemporalPred.eval_at tp t = temporal_truth M atomMap t tp.formula is a function of the single world t=env 0 only, invariant under changing env at positions >=1; but the RHS reads M.interp p (env j) and env i < env j at the free positions j>=1. No base/formula (navigating or otherwise) can bridge this. Delivered TWO green, sorry-free, machine-checked refutations in Base.lean (axioms exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]): (1) endCharN0_correct_world_local_obstruction — any world-local base forces nf_eval_nf to be env->=1-independent; (2) endCharN0_correct_infeasible — a concrete Bool counter-model where no base exists, deriving False at n=2. Module stays GREEN (1005/1005), sorry-free, 0 new axioms, 0 vacuous defs; the preserved skeleton (nf_eval_nf_step_unfold, EndCharMotive, atomPartN, nf_endpoint_tl_gen(+_correct), nfN_locus0, endCharN0 def, endCharN0_wlocus_correct, seg/seg_holds_coupled) is untouched. NOT faked green: endCharN0_correct itself is NOT claimed — it is proven impossible. Did NOT reintroduce a residual/h_nav (the refuted v2 route). The obstruction points squarely to the plan's contingency: Rabinovich Lemma 3.2(2) <=2-free-variable reduction (cap arity at <=3, reduce env to navigation witnesses BEFORE navigating). Phase 6 inherits the identical world-locality wall one arity up and is expected to fail the same way; the arity must be capped, not climbed.

blockers.lean_goal_state: ⊢ (∀ (p : sig.preds), M.interp p (env 0) ↔ qnf (AtomKind.pred p 0) = true) ↔ ∀ (a : AtomKind sig n), atom_eval M env a ↔ qnf a = true
blockers.lean_goal_state_note: Captured via lean_goal after `rw [endCharN0_wlocus_correct ...]` (green) + `simp only [nf_eval_nf]`. LHS depends only on env 0; RHS ranges over AtomKind.pred p j (= M.interp p (env j)) and AtomKind.order i j h (= env i < env j) for free positions j>=1.
blockers.obstruction: TemporalPred.eval_at tp t := temporal_truth M atomMap t tp.formula (ExistsForallNF.lean:53) is a function of the single world t=env 0 (and M, formula) ONLY — it cannot depend on env 1 .. env (n-1). The frozen RHS nf_eval_nf M 0 n env qnf (NormalForm.lean:198) is (∀ a : AtomKind sig n, atom_eval M env a ↔ qnf a = true), which reads M.interp p (env j) for every position j (NormalForm.lean:113). For arbitrary env with n>=2, varying env at position 1 changes the RHS but not the LHS, so the biconditional is a non-theorem for EVERY candidate base. Navigation cannot help: Until/Since reach model-order-determined points, never the externally-supplied arbitrary env j.
evidence: Theories/Bimodal/Metalogic/WeakCanonical/Kamp/NfMultiAnchorBridge/Base.lean :: endCharN0_correct_world_local_obstruction (green, sorry-free, axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]) — any base H satisfying the frozen biconditional forces nf_eval_nf M 0 n env qnf ↔ nf_eval_nf M 0 n env' qnf whenever env 0 = env' 0.

Theories/Bimodal/Metalogic/WeakCanonical/Kamp/NfMultiAnchorBridge/Base.lean :: endCharN0_correct_infeasible (green, sorry-free, axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]) — concrete model Mcex (carrier Bool, one predicate holding at true), no base exists; instantiates the obstruction at n=2 with env=(fun _ => false), env'=Fin.cons false (fun _ => true) to derive False from the pred-atom clause at position 1.
Existing green endCharN0_wlocus_correct proves the preserved endCharN0's eval at env 0 reads exactly the position-0 predicate layer — the LHS of the stuck goal.
